ui: text-first; narrative may be extensive; preserve full semantic and evidential detail

rules.encode: Use the smallest lossless representation; compact JSON/keys/IDs/enums where safe.
rules.model: Normalize shared entities; store facts once; link by stable IDs; use deltas/events instead of duplicate snapshots.
rules.text: Do not truncate meaningful narrative, evidence, chronology, dialogue, or provenance merely to save bytes. Compress structure, not meaning.
optimise: use appropriate compression/external object storage only when cheaper and justified
apply retention only where canon permits
rules.gate: Before EVERY Neon schema/data deployment, migration, seed/import, bulk write, or upload: estimate incremental storage in bytes and MB, show method/assumptions/range, current baseline, and projected total; WAIT for explicit user approval. No deployment on estimate alone.
rules.verify: After approval and deployment, measure actual database/table/index/TOAST growth and report delta vs estimate. If size cannot be credibly estimated, do not deploy; design a measurement/benchmark first.
rules.baseline: 2026-11-22: production branch logical_size=33611776 bytes=32.05 MiB (33.61 MB decimal); existing baseline, not a proposed deployment.
